description: This file defines a set of React components and hooks for a sidebar UI element, including context management, toggle controls, and various subcomponents for layout and interaction.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom hook to access sidebar context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: Context provider component managing sidebar state, including open/close, mobile toggle, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Main sidebar component supporting different variants, sides, and collapsible modes, with responsive behavior for mobile.

methods.name: SidebarTrigger
methods.description: Button component to toggle the sidebar, with icon and accessibility features.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button for toggling sidebar in rail mode, with resize cursor and styling.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content area for inset sidebar variant.

methods.name: SidebarInput
methods.description: Styled input component for sidebar search or input fields.

methods.name: SidebarHeader
methods.description: Header container for sidebar sections.

methods.name: SidebarFooter
methods.description: Footer container for sidebar sections.

methods.name: SidebarSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator component within sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarContent
methods.description: Main content container inside the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarGroup
methods.description: Container for grouping sidebar items.

methods.name: SidebarGroupLabel
methods.description: Label for sidebar groups, supports child slot.

methods.name: SidebarGroupAction
methods.description: Action button for sidebar groups, with icon and hover effects.

methods.name: SidebarGroupContent
methods.description: Content area for sidebar groups.

methods.name: SidebarMenu
methods.description: Container for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuItem
methods.description: Individual menu item in sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarMenuButton
methods.description: Button for sidebar menu, supports tooltip and active state.

methods.name: SidebarMenuAction
methods.description: Action button within sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuBadge
methods.description: Badge indicator for menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
methods.description: Loading skeleton for menu placeholder.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSub
methods.description: Sub-menu container.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubItem
methods.description: Sub-menu item.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubButton
methods.description: Button for sub-menu items, supports active state and child slot.
